name: Beloe Bezmolvie
source: A reimagining of the original story of [url=/v3126]Beskonechnoe leto[/url] with a new protagonist who, by chance, finds himself in an alternative era of the USSR. Summer, camp, new friends, and a second youth, what could be better, right? Having initially been delighted with the opportunities that have opened up, the protagonist discovers that the place he has found himself in holds many secrets and dangers. He and other pioneers will need all their wits, courage, and resourcefulness to cope with the unexpected onset of arctic cold and other equally difficult challenges.
